# Analytical method

Apply this adaptation of the [generic novel method](../../governance/analytical-methods/GENERIC_NOVEL_ANALYTICAL_METHOD.md) to the authorized Japanese witnesses in publication order. The [witness map](KSOA_SOURCE_AND_WITNESS_MAP.md) governs exact locators and coverage. The [architecture](KSOA_SYNTHESIS_ARCHITECTURE.md) governs cumulative destinations and closeout. The [current entrypoint](CURRENT_STATE_AND_CORPUS_MAP.md) owns the analysis lock and run state.

## Start at the authorized frontier

V01 through V07 are the atomic repository reading units. Within each volume, read prologue, numbered chapters and epilogue in witnessed order. Take finer scene or passage freezes immediately before a major disclosure where the distinction matters. Start with an entering record that identifies the volume, witness, authorized endpoint, previous accepted freeze, reader exposure and entering knowledge for the relevant characters. Load the prior frozen state and only prior authorized text and records. Restrict previews, search, OCR, opening links and extraction to the current interval. Use bibliographic titles for witness identity. Keep publisher summaries, adaptations, prior memories, later navigation headings, spoiler-bearing paratext and retrospective files out of the prospective working view. Log unavoidable material exposure with its affected scope. A contaminated view may support explicitly qualified retrospective work. An independent, unexposed pass is needed for a genuinely blind result.

## Track three orders

| Order | What to record |
|---|---|
| Fictional events | Actual, alleged or inferred occurrence, relative or absolute time, participants and causal dependencies. Use ranges and competing sequences for disputed chronology. Maintain a provisional sequence through the reading and a separately labeled, endpoint-bounded reconstruction when warranted. |
| Investigation | Who encountered which object, testimony or inference, in what order and through which action. Track collection, interpretation, circulation, withholding, error and consequences. Discovery by one person establishes access only for that person unless transmission is evidenced. |
| Narration | When the reader receives information, with whose focalization and framing, at what level of explicitness and emphasis. Track gaps, reordered scenes, reported memories, withheld facts, apparent salience and information known to the reader alone. |

Tie the three orders through the same evidence IDs. A later recollection may concern an earlier event while entering the investigation and the reader's knowledge at separate points. Give an uncertainty and source locator to each asserted time or dependency.

## Assess evidence and hypotheses

Record presentation and judgment independently. Classify the source as a directly represented event or observation, narratorial assertion, character testimony, or character belief, with speaker, focalizer, receiver and access route. Then identify the analytical proposition as an investigative hypothesis, source-supported inference, unverified speculation, contradicted or revised claim, or retrospectively established explanation when applicable. This permits a directly represented utterance to establish that a character spoke while its content remains testimony or belief. A narrator may report someone's inference or limited perception. Assign scope, degree of support, known conflicts and plausible alternatives to each consequential proposition.

Test claims of intent, lying and investigative error against opportunity, knowledge at the time, possible memory error, misunderstanding, limited access, withholding and affirmative evidence of deception. Treat an accusation as an attributed investigative claim and track how its basis holds up. Require corroboration or a sufficiently warranted textual convergence before labeling an explanation established, and record residual ambiguity even if a novel closes an investigation. Preserve a source locator for every material link in the causal chain and evidence for viable alternatives.

## Freeze before looking ahead

At each section close, record the exact exclusive predecessor endpoint (or member opening) and inclusive end of the disclosed span, its predecessor, reader and investigator knowledge, knowledge of relevant other characters, unresolved alternatives and counterevidence. Use the [disclosure ledger](KSOA_DISCLOSURE_AND_HYPOTHESIS_LEDGER.md) to record what the prior horizon allowed a reader or investigator to infer. Save the exact snapshot in the authorized working environment and record its capture time and SHA-256 before opening the next span. Carry the same contents into the accepted volume transaction. Freeze hypothesis wording, supporting and weakening evidence, predicted discriminators and any material exposure limit. Record subsequent revelations as new rows with their actual disclosure horizon. Keep the original snapshot and its confidence recoverable from the volume's committed bytes.

At case close, audit each load-bearing inference at the last relevant pre-reveal horizon. Ask whether the diagnostic clue was already available, legible, emphasized or obscured, available to which party, and how well the clue discriminated among the recorded alternatives. Separate textual availability, reasonable inferability and uniqueness of inference. Identify explanations that depend materially on newly introduced facts. An explicit reveal can clarify an earlier clue without proving that the earlier clue uniquely determined the outcome. Apply a fair-play question where the novel invites it, and record when its narrative design serves a different purpose.

## Read the prose and the institution

- Examine who narrates, whose attention and interiority govern each passage, how transitions and pacing control uncertainty, and how descriptive selection makes a place, object or utterance salient. Verify original Japanese wording, ruby, orthography, punctuation, forms of address, politeness, indirect speech, and register in context. Record a gloss as a gloss and identify what it loses. Treat translation differences and alternative readings as claims with their own basis. Label quotations as verified exact, working transcription or paraphrase. Verify load-bearing wording against the native witness, using minimal excerpts only where permitted by publication rules.
- Record depicted evidence handling, interview or witness interactions, reporting and corroboration, division of responsibility, jurisdiction and discretion, cooperation and constraint, and ethical judgment. Attribute assertions about authority to their speakers or narrators. Trace how a rule, resource, delay or discretionary choice changed the investigation when the evidence supports the connection. Claims about actual Japanese law or police practice belong to separately sourced context with a jurisdiction, date, primary authority and scope of comparison. Fictional conduct alone establishes a portrayal.
- Record choices and pressures outside the investigation as well as case conduct. Distinguish internal intention from attributed or observed behavior, expressed emotion from inferred motivation, professional role from private disposition and situational response from a demonstrated tendency. Follow directed changes in familiarity, intimacy, operational and interpersonal trust, obligation, conflict and attachment. Evaluate the central partnership across actual choices and disclosures. Any romantic interpretation requires affirmative evidence and plausible counterreadings. Retain case-local subjects' goals, decisions, constraints and causal consequences in their own right.
- Test whether Kamakura geography, local history, cultural institutions or social relationships affect access, movement, evidence, motive, decisions or interpretive structure. Distinguish atmosphere, causal function and thematic significance by naming the mechanism and testing a competing reading. Accumulate repeated language or motifs with variation, counterexamples and opportunity. Recurrence starts a question about theme.

## Close the volume transaction

The reading contains an entering boundary, complete source coverage and apparatus dispositions, a section-by-section literary argument with exact evidence references, focalization and a plausible counterreading, frozen prospective snapshots, retrospective case reconstruction and unresolved matters, character/relationship/institutional changes and warranted revisions. The owning reading records the source locators of material non-case passages. Use the [case evidence ledger](KSOA_CASE_EVIDENCE_LEDGER.md) for case evidence and investigation, the [character and relationship ledger](KSOA_CHARACTER_AND_RELATIONSHIP_LEDGER.md) for state, and the [claim revision ledger](KSOA_CLAIM_REVISION_LEDGER.md) for interpretive conclusions that need longitudinal retrieval. Include needed counterevidence and plausible alternative readings. Review important Japanese references and named subjects at their disclosure boundary.

Check the entire authorized span against the witness map, link ledger deltas or explain why no delta is warranted, verify consequential locators and forward-reference boundaries, and freeze the exiting state. Update the coverage and current high-water mark with the reading and ledger changes in the same accepted unit transaction. The next volume requires a new authorization or an existing continuous run whose explicit boundary includes it.

# Character reconstruction specification

Use the [generic reconstruction method](../../governance/analytical-methods/GENERIC_CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_METHOD.md) for derived work on recurring or case-local characters. The [literary method](KSOA_ANALYTICAL_METHOD.md) and [claim revision ledger](KSOA_CLAIM_REVISION_LEDGER.md) retain authority over interpretations. A reconstruction supports a scoped account of how a character appraises a situation and chooses among plausible responses. Its intended uses include monographs, conditional behavior and dialogue, directed interpersonal interaction, professional decisions, and clearly qualified counterfactual or cross-series scenarios. No subject has been assessed at bootstrap.

## Scope and evidence

Bind each candidate to an exact subject and continuity, witness set, admitted source boundary, basis commit, generation, model version, story-time state, reader evidence horizon, and the character's own knowledge and access at that point. Name excluded witnesses, evidence the author has already seen and missing evidence channels. If a later disclosure supports a revised account of the earlier person, label that evidence basis retrospective. A model at that earlier story time can act only on information available to that person then. Preserve earlier, more limited reconstructions as distinct versions with their own evidence horizons.

Build a model evidence map using stable source and state anchors in the [character and relationship ledger](KSOA_CHARACTER_AND_RELATIONSHIP_LEDGER.md), [case evidence ledger](KSOA_CASE_EVIDENCE_LEDGER.md), [disclosure ledger](KSOA_DISCLOSURE_AND_HYPOTHESIS_LEDGER.md) and accepted volume readings. Each input records the exact locator, evidence class, situation, interlocutor/audience, institutional role, subject state, and basis for its permitted use.

| Evidence route | Application |
|---|---|
| Observed conduct | Acts, choices and consequences, with opportunity, pressures, and actual options |
| Narrated interiority | Explicit access, focalizer, thought or affect, and what the character expresses or withholds |
| Dialogue and linguistic register | Japanese speaker and addressee, scene and speech act, address and self-reference, honorifics, politeness, sentence endings, indirectness and register shifts |
| Reports and institutional claims | Who attributes the conduct, role or duty, their access and possible interest, and independent corroboration |
| Context and relationships | Professional authority, duty, resources, social pressure, relative knowledge and directed history with the interlocutor |
| Stable and contingent tendencies | Recurrence across credible opportunities, role or stress alternatives, valid intervals and whether a change occurred or an earlier condition was revealed |
| Conflict, limits and uncertainty | Disconfirming observations, rivals, evidence-backed limitations, gaps and conditions for abstention |
| Character knowledge | Subject-specific disclosures, belief/error, transmission and event time, with the reader's confirmation horizon recorded independently |

Sample ordinary scenes, professional routine, asymmetric interpersonal situations and pressure where available. The source may support a narrow decision or interaction for a case-local character and leave private motivation, ordinary behavior or voice largely open. Mark the limits for each intended use. A missing opportunity is a coverage gap. A negative constraint needs affirmative evidence or a genuinely diagnostic opportunity.

## Model and uses

Keep the literary monograph, evidence crosswalk, operational model and test records distinct in responsibility. State any proposed policy as trigger, perceived stakes and options, relevant role and relationship, response family, inhibitors, alternatives, counterevidence and failure condition. Give the rule a scoped confidence (high, moderate, low or open) and an attested, close-variant, novel in-world or cross-scenario distance. Confidence ordinarily decreases with distance. Preserve reasons for declining a prediction.

For dialogue, work from objective and speech act to interlocutor-conditioned register and wording. Include Japanese coverage across relevant interlocutors and contexts, with samples that test what would sound wrong, and judge the decision to speak separately from fidelity of expression. Preserve ruby, punctuation and context where meaningful. Where the source presents thought and speech separately, require independent grounds for making an internal judgment audible. A cross-scenario contract states assumed chronology, setting, interlocutor relationship, authority, facts available to the character and which novel conditions are altered. A future interpretive readiness review tests whether the source coverage and counterevidence can support a specified reconstruction purpose and state. It checks locators, stability versus contingency, uncertainty, ordinary and pressured behavior, interpersonal direction and sufficient original-language dialogue for the claimed range. A credible monograph or well-supported hypothesis may inform this decision. Operational validation requires a distinct authorized test and result. This specification records neither a readiness judgment nor a capability tier.

1. **Freeze the basis and test plan.** Pin candidate model version, exact evidence, temporal/state boundary, intended scenario and qualitative acceptance criteria. An independent custodian withholds genuinely unexposed passages or units with diagnostic opportunities, including routine and pressure contexts and relevant dialogue or relationships. Freeze rules, predicted response families, alternatives, confidence, disconfirmers and expected abstentions at the permitted knowledge horizon before releasing the test material. Record exposure and input boundaries for the producer and reviewer. Reserve further held-out material for any later retest.
2. **Run scoped tests.** Compare the frozen predictions with verified Japanese passages and the exact information available to the subject. Include perturbations of role, available evidence or interlocutor, plausible decoys, abstention controls and a generic-profile baseline where they can discriminate. Treat already seen passages as retrospective replay. Label noncanonical probes and use them to test consistency and bounds. Their outcomes carry no new canon facts.
3. **Adjudicate independently.** Preserve the original predictions. Record diagnostic opportunity, source locator, supported/partly supported/contradicted/confounded/unresolved outcome or absence of opportunity, and reviewer rationale. Report the number of opportunities and exclusions by context, and calibrate confidence against disconfirmations. Avoid percentages from small or selected samples. ## Evidence, state and revision

A mature claim links to its claim/version ID and stable section anchor, then to an evidence ID in the owning volume reading or case ledger, and from there to the exact witness, section, ZIP member and paragraph or element address. Use the volume reading for verified Japanese wording and glosses, and the witness map for packaging details. Use a dedicated retrieval matrix only when cross-case support or a body of disputed passages becomes hard to audit through those routes. A matrix points to the original evidence and claim IDs.

Maintain distinct event time, source disclosure and the evidence horizon at which a state is asserted. A character's later admission may clarify a prior motive, but it enters the reader's evidence horizon at its disclosure point. Classify potential conflicts before adjudication. Check differences in event time or reporting order, access or focalization, attribution, memory, deception, institutional reporting, language, edition and continuity. If two accounts remain incompatible, preserve both with diagnostic evidence, an explicit open issue and any targeted audit it warrants.

If V05 bears on a V01 inference, the V05 reading supplies new evidence IDs and a new horizon. The claim ledger links the V01 version to a V05 adjudication using the archive transitions, with support and counterevidence. Any changed character or institutional state gets its own dated state row. If the text has revealed an earlier condition rather than depicted a new change, record its original valid time and its V05 disclosure. Cite the V01 freeze for what could have been inferred then and the current eligible claim for the later interpretation. Revised claims route to dependent specialist sections through the ledger. Corrections to frozen material use attributable errata or successors, with reciprocal artifact supersession where applicable.

## Specialist and character studies

Before full-series integration, answer three questions using the completed corpus. Treat these as required responsibilities that can share a document when the evidence and argument overlap.

1. **Mystery form and causality.** Compare how cases distribute clues, hypotheses and investigative discoveries and how their resolutions earn or complicate retrospective coherence. Depend on case and disclosure reconciliation, including plausible alternatives and material information introduced after a reveal.
2. **Character and partnership.** Explain how recurring professional and private decisions, forms of address and asymmetric trust change across cases. Use baseline, turning-point, ordinary-life and counterexample evidence. Create monographs for subjects with distinct developmental or interpretive questions and sufficient independent evidence. Create a directed relationship or ensemble study when interaction itself needs sustained argument across cases. A case-local subject may warrant focused analysis where their agency and perspective materially affect the local case or the series argument.
3. **Policing, setting and literary form.** Examine how portrayed institutions, ethics and Kamakura's social and physical setting constrain actions and how narration makes those constraints meaningful. Test variation across cases. Keep any real-world comparison independently sourced and distinct from literary evidence.

Create specialist documents under `studies/` inside this project root when an argument requires its own home. Voice and language, geography/local history, and recurring thematic or ethical conflicts are anticipated specialist topics. Their breadth and standalone treatment depend on the actual readings. Keep local literary arguments in their volume readings when they have no material longitudinal role. The reconstruction specification governs possible derived work after evidence stabilizes. A monograph may supply input, and a tested reconstruction may prompt a new source check. Literary completion and reconstruction validation have separate acceptance decisions.
